# MiniElephant Electric Wheelchair

> Professional electric wheelchair manufacturer. B2B export of lightweight folding electric wheelchairs with magnesium alloy frames.

## Company

- **Brand**: MiniElephant
- **Company**: [Jiaxing Small Elephant Medical Technology Co., Ltd](https://www.semwheelchair.com)
- **Location**: Zhejiang, China
- **Contact**: Johnson — [johnson@semwheelchair.com](mailto:johnson@semwheelchair.com) / [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/8613819098967)

## Products

The **MiniRedone Series** — 10 folding electric wheelchair models:

- [MiniRedone-I](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i) — Base model, 47KG
- [MiniRedone-I-W](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-i-w) — White edition, 46KG
- [MiniRedone-II](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-ii) — Ultra-light portable, 42KG
- [MiniRedone-II-Plus](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-ii-plus) — Wide seat, 45KG
- [MiniRedone-III](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-iii) — Premium high-back
- [MiniRedone-IV](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-iv) — Tall backrest, 43KG
- [MiniRedone-V](https://www.semwheelchair.com/products/miniredone-v) — Extra wide, W900mm

## Specifications

- **Frame**: Magnesium Alloy
- **Motors**: Dual 350W Brushless
- **Battery**: 16Ah Lithium
- **Range**: ≈30 KM
- **Load**: 150 KG
- **Speed**: ≤6 KM/H
- **Certifications**: ISO 13485, CE, FDA
